# 4 bed detached house for sale

> An attractive B rated double fronted detached 4 Bedroom residence ideally situated fronting the open green in a tranquil cul de sac setting with an enviable sunny westerly aspect. Substantially refurbished and upgraded with a high quality specification throughout, the natural light filled interiors extend to c. 172 sq m (1,851 sq ft) plus a superbly converted Attic of 17.32 sq m (186 sq ft).
